title: How the Xcode 27 MCP can lead to higher token costs when navigating the Simulator
summary: Antoine van der Lee compares Xcode 27.1 MCP and his RocketSim CLI across ten Simulator scenarios in three rounds, with an independent app-state check after each run. An iOS team can measure the output its agent reads and reserve screenshots for visual checks; the reported token gap is a byte-based estimate from one scripted fixture, not live model usage or billing.
takeaway: Benchmark navigation output and independent completion checks on your own app; compare hierarchy size, missed interactions, calls, and build support before choosing a tool.
